subject.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue

question: Should a durable wake queued for an agent session remain deliverable after that session is reset, or must it be fenced to the session generation that owned the original wake?
rationale: The existing queue deliberately distinguishes generation-fenced `agentTurn` entries from cross-generation `systemEvent` entries, and this PR selects the latter for durable wakes; source inspection and live proof establish behavior but cannot determine the intended user-facing reset contract.

options.title: Fence wake generations
options.body: Capture the owning session generation and skip, supersede, or leave inspectable any wake whose session was reset before delivery.

options.title: Allow cross-reset attention
options.body: Keep `systemEvent` semantics across resets, but document that durable attention survives `/new` and add an explicit reset/restart behavior test.

options.title: Defer durable handoff
options.body: Keep wake inspection only and postpone automatic session-queue handoff until a broader durable-session lifecycle contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Fence wake generations
recommendation.body: Capture the owning session generation and skip, supersede, or leave inspectable any wake whose session was reset before delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the session-delivery queue and its generation-sensitive continuation semantics.
